indicators: server-hemera-mongo 0.0.15 published 2026-11-03 22:12 UTC, no longer served by the npm registry since 2026-11-04
Part of the hijack of 12 releases in 10 packages (@adminide-stack and others); OSV covers the other 11 (MAL-2026-18639 to MAL-2026-18647, MAL-2026-11986)
summary: A hijacked release of server-hemera-mongo (0.0.15) carried a loader that, when the package is loaded, downloads and runs a remote-access tool. It is the only release of this campaign that OSV does not list yet.
remediation: Make sure no lockfile resolves server-hemera-mongo 0.0.15 (the registry no longer serves it; 0.0.11 is the current version). If 0.0.15 was installed and loaded, treat that machine as compromised: rotate every credential it could read (npm, Git, cloud, .env files) and check npm and editor startup files for unknown entries.
